title: ReplaceLine Comprehensive Examples - Multi-Language Testing
instructions: Create exhaustive examples demonstrating ReplaceLine tool across multiple programming languages (Python, PHP, JavaScript, Java, Rust, Go, C++, Ruby, TypeScript, C#). Cover all scenarios: single line replacement, multi-line block replacement, replacements at beginning, middle, and end of files. Include proper indentation handling, special characters, and edge cases. Each example should be a complete, runnable code snippet that gets modified.
